test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘GRANTED’ is written as ‘HPBLUCE’ and ‘FRAGMENT’ is written as ‘GPBENCOR’. How will ‘IGNORE’ be written in that language?
solution:
Explanation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e82b7da6e41b2a069e2db44b7b686c69a4d8afae6d389dc05a659aaeaa56953.png] 

According to English alphabet series

‘GRANTED’ is written as ‘HPBLUCE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/32dc268d4943ce1c5e76380c84eb4f6c5152d674e327483ab4c9c00176b2a652.png] 

And

 ‘FRAGMENT’ is written as ‘GPBENCOR’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b6db23f5dc49a779aa77c7e12bf02f09cc60657304f13d53c7db5868e8d54ff5.png] 

Similarly,

‘IGNORE’ is written as JEOMSC

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/77c5ce8e45708cd58712353b7f6a9bf88aefa23926ffb528b3f666ab47ce506e.png] 

Hence,** "Option 4" i**s the **correct answer.**
